button.why: one control: no content to empty or repeat

card.why: a title and a subtitle: no list to empty or repeat

composer.why: one input: no content to empty or repeat

diagram.why: its source is one diagram: rows are the diagram's own syntax, not the kind's

editor.why: one text buffer: no rows to empty or repeat

hero.why: a hero has a few calls to action, never hundreds

images.why: an image's alt is not drawn as text

island.why: its props belong to the app's component: no rows the kind draws

media.why: one picture: nothing to empty or repeat

nav.why: a nav bar holds a few links, never hundreds

row.why: one row: its list is the list kind's many

run.why: one command: nothing to empty or repeat

secret.why: one secret field: no rows to empty or repeat

stat.why: one number and its label: nothing to empty or repeat

text.why: one text: its empty is no block at all

web.why: an embedded page: its text and rows are the page's, not the kind's
